results.name: two devices of one member and a distinct member share the household
the Dashboard shows the Current card and five empty place cards
the Current card uses the device position, or an approximate one labelled as such, and links to the right forecast
places saved on one device reach the other device and its Dashboard cards, in both directions
another member sees none of a member's places and cannot read or delete them
choosing a place for a Dashboard card moves it on every device and a card holds one place at a time
the Celsius or Fahrenheit choice follows the member to their other device and does not change another member's cards
Core's Add opens the add-a-place sheet and Escape closes it
after a full restart while offline the Dashboard and the places load with their last forecast; changes made offline survive another restart
reconnect delivers every queued change without conflicts and the other device agrees
a stale offline edit is surfaced for review and the shared version stays on screen
no horizontal overflow at 390, 768 and 1440 px, every card fills its box, and no page errors
the axe pass (WCAG 2.0 and 2.1 A and AA) finds no violation on 9 screens
removing a place removes it everywhere
